title: fuzz targets fail to build with Linux clang default (gnu17): [[nodiscard]] in schnorr48.h needs C23
description: lichen/tests/fuzz fuzz_schnorr48 with Linux clang + libFuzzer (waves-base workstation, clang default -std=gnu17) fails parsing lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/schnorr48.h:107/122/149 'error: expected expression' — the [[nodiscard]] C23 attribute. macOS AppleClang 21 defaults to gnu23 so the host build passes (m9m4 verified there). Fix candidate: force a C23-or-later std (e.g. target_compile_options(... -std=c2x)) in lichen/tests/fuzz/CMakeLists.txt, or guard the attribute for pre-C23. Discovered while verifying m9m4 on the workstation; pre-existing, unrelated to the include-dir fix (build previously died earlier at lichen/lichen_log.h).
